# Pinned scanner 1.0.0

Kura uses the [stable SDK Maven bundle](https://github.com/phillip9933/open-android-doc-scanner/releases/tag/v1.0.0).
The tag resolves to `b00b4f14ec0259edd748c2292418faf1b123a2f7`. The published
ZIP has SHA-256 `0675b8cc1b7fd552bf342bd17066d510c857c528f1ceefb7ce4bf8e186bfba10`.

All 23 upstream Maven SHA-256 sidecars match their files. Kura retains the
SDK files and notices and adds this provenance, the source revision, and a
checksum manifest for the complete vendored directory. The enhanced build
verifies that manifest and checks its English and Japanese OCR model pins.
